GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well faced breeze 1 length off, improved turn, joint lead Straightening Up , headed 200m and dropped out # faced breeze
Jumped Ok went to front. led 6 lengths mid race. led 6 lengths. turn. kept going in Straight # much too good

Best away. Pushed fwd & led quickly on inside (2L clear) early . Held lead on inside midrace 4L clear @ 600m. Pushed to quicken @ 400m & 3L clear on home turn. Pressured @ 200m but weakened quickly in last 150m. RIder queried. # Led & folded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported he had been instructed to lead outright as the mare does not respond well when pressured by other runners. After being ridden along to lead, set fast sectionals during the early and middle stages and was unable to sustain a strong finishing effort when resuming. Rider conceded that, in hindsight, he should have made a greater effort to restrain the mare during the middle stages. Trainer confirmed the instructions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Worked fwd until led on rail by 3/4L early . Held lead on inside midrace until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 400m. Pushed along =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Headed @ 250m & weakened in last 200m. Vetted clear. # Led & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jockey could offer no explanation for the performance of the mare, which failed to respond to his riding or quicken in the straight. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities. Trnr: recovered well but to nevertheless freshen up prior to next start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up 2-3l clear and kept going strong to the line # led/no danger
Jumped Well faced breeze 1 length off, pushed along a touch turn, Straightened Up half off, run ended 200m and weakened to the line # faced breeze
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jockey reported that his mount failed to let down, with its action deteriorating over the concluding stages on the soft track conditions. Trainer reported that the mare also had its tongue over the bit on return to scale and that she will now add a tongue tie to the mare’s official race gear. A post-race veterinary examination revealed a slow recovery rate.
